redFlagH.q1: With waiters, cashiers, delivery drivers, he is…
redFlagH.q1a: Polite, even friendly, even when things drag.
redFlagH.q1c: Short or irritated the moment something goes wrong.
redFlagH.q1d: Contemptuous: "it's their job", and you can hear it in his voice.
redFlagH.q2: When he talks about his exes…
redFlagH.q2a: With some perspective, no scores to settle.
redFlagH.q2d: They were all crazy, all bitches, and he never did anything wrong.
redFlagH.q3: The pace at the start: the "I love you", the plans, "we were made for each other"…
redFlagH.q3a: A normal pace, we're getting to know each other.
redFlagH.q3b: He moves fast, but I'm fine with it.
redFlagH.q3c: Very fast: declarations, gifts, messages at all hours from the first days.
redFlagH.q3d: He was already talking about the future and living together before he knew me, and since then his tone has changed.
redFlagH.q4: When you say no (to going out, to a gesture, to sex)…
redFlagH.q4a: It's a no, and he doesn't come back to it.
redFlagH.q4b: He pushes a little, then drops it.
redFlagH.q4c: He sulks, or makes me feel guilty.
redFlagH.q4d: He doesn't let go until I give in.
redFlagH.q5: Your phone, your messages, your evenings out…
redFlagH.q5a: He doesn't concern himself with them.
redFlagH.q5b: He sometimes asks who's texting me, in passing.
redFlagH.q5c: He wants to know who I'm talking to and where I am, and some answers make him angry.
redFlagH.q5d: He has already gone through my phone, or he wants my passcodes and my location.
redFlagH.q6: When something annoys him (a delay, a disagreement, a remark)…
redFlagH.q6a: He says so calmly, or he moves on.
redFlagH.q6b: He gets irritated, then it passes quickly.
redFlagH.q6c: He gets seriously angry, over not much.
redFlagH.q6d: He explodes: he shouts, insults, slams doors.
redFlagH.q7: After an argument, or when he's wrong…
redFlagH.q7a: He apologises, and something changes afterwards.
redFlagH.q7b: He apologises half-heartedly, just to make it stop.
redFlagH.q7c: In the end it's always a bit my fault, or I'm "too sensitive".
redFlagH.q7d: He never apologises: I'm the one who ends up saying sorry.
redFlagH.q8a: Match: when he says it, he does it.
redFlagH.q8c: He promises a lot, cancels often, and it's up to me to reschedule.
redFlagH.q8d: I can't count on what he says.
redFlagH.q9: Physical anger: a fist in the wall, something thrown, a door slammed hard…
redFlagH.q9b: A slammed door, once, in a big argument.
redFlagH.q9c: He has already broken or thrown something in front of me.
redFlagH.q9d: He has already raised his hand to me, or hurt me "without meaning to".
redFlagH.q10: Honestly, when you're with him, you feel…
redFlagH.q10b: Good, with a small doubt now and then.
redFlagH.q10c: Often on my guard: I'm careful about what I say.
redFlagH.q10d: I'm sometimes afraid of how he'll react.
redFlagH.q11: The little digs, the "it was just a joke"…
redFlagH.q11a: We tease each other, and it stays kind.
redFlagH.q11b: He sometimes makes jokes that are a bit much.
redFlagH.q11c: He makes fun of me in front of others, then says I have no sense of humour.
redFlagH.q11d: He puts me down, my looks, my job, what I say, in private or in public.
redFlagH.q12: When you tell him about your day…
redFlagH.q12b: He listens, half of the time.
redFlagH.q12c: He's on his phone, or quickly brings the conversation back to himself.
redFlagH.q12d: He never asks me anything: I'm his audience.
redFlagH.q13a: He gets on with them, or makes the effort.
redFlagH.q13b: He doesn't love them, but keeps it to himself.
redFlagH.q13c: He often criticises the people close to me, or sulks when I see them.
redFlagH.q13d: I see them a lot less since I've been with him, and that's no accident.
redFlagH.q14b: Small bends of the truth, with no consequences.
redFlagH.q14c: I've already caught him red-handed on something that mattered.
redFlagH.q14d: I check what he says, because I no longer know what's true.
redFlagH.q15a: He's steady: I know what to expect.
redFlagH.q15b: He has ups and downs, like everyone.
redFlagH.q15c: Very present, then no news for days, with no explanation.
redFlagH.q15d: I never know which version of him I'm going to get.
redFlagH.q16: What the people close to you say about him…
redFlagH.q16b: They don't have a strong opinion.
redFlagH.q16c: One or two have told me to be careful.
redFlagH.q16d: Several have warned me, and I avoid the subject with them.
redFlagH.q17b: A touch of jealousy now and then, said with a laugh.
redFlagH.q17c: He doesn't like me seeing certain friends, or going out without him.
redFlagH.q17d: He makes scenes, asks for proof, or decides what he will "let" me do.
redFlagH.q18: The way he talks about women in general (his colleagues, a stranger in the street, "girls")…
redFlagH.q18d: Real contempt, "that's a woman's job", and "you're not like them".
redFlagH.q19b: He sometimes drinks a bit too much, without consequences.
redFlagH.q19c: When he's been drinking, he changes: heavy, hurtful, or aggressive.
redFlagH.q19d: I've already been ashamed or afraid of him on a night out, because of what he becomes.
redFlagH.q20a: Each of us does our share, or we just talk about it.
redFlagH.q20b: We don't see things the same way, but we talk about it.
redFlagH.q20c: He keeps count of everything, or always lets me pay.
redFlagH.q20d: He has borrowed money from me without paying it back, or he controls mine.
redFlagH.modesTitre: The person you're thinking of is…
redFlagH.modesDesc: The questions change with your answer: what people notice in a man and in a woman isn't quite the same.
